name: Provelopers Connector for TikTok Shop
author: Provelopers

sections.description:
Provelopers Connector for TikTok Shop integrates WooCommerce with TikTok Shop. It provides tools for connecting a TikTok Shop account, importing products into WooCommerce, reviewing logs, and managing sync-related settings from the WordPress admin area.

This readme primarily describes the features available in the WordPress.org version of the plugin.

Free Version Features

WooCommerce Product Import from TikTok Shop
Import products from your TikTok Shop directly into WooCommerce. The free version supports importing basic product information, including title, SKU, price, and description.

Stock and Inventory Updates
Manually trigger stock updates from TikTok Shop to keep your WooCommerce inventory aligned whenever needed.

Bulk Import
Import multiple products at once with support for up to 50 products per batch, making it easy to get started without manual one-by-one imports.

Admin Dashboard
A clean, basic dashboard provides a sync status overview and basic sync logs to track recent activity.

Access Control
Basic admin-level access to all free plugin features ensures that only authorized users can manage the integration.

Notes

The plugin may also have additional functionality outside the WordPress.org version. If you maintain multiple editions, keep the WordPress.org listing focused on the features available in this public release.

External services

This plugin connects to TikTok Shop APIs to authenticate the store connection and import product data into WooCommerce.

It connects to the following TikTok services:

  • https://auth.tiktok-shops.com for OAuth authorization, token exchange, and token refresh.
  • https://open-api.us.tiktokshop.com and https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com for account and product API requests, depending on the configured region.

The plugin sends data to TikTok Shop only when the site administrator connects the plugin to a TikTok Shop account or performs API-related actions such as testing the connection, fetching the shop cipher, refreshing tokens, or importing products.

This may include:

  • App key and app secret.
  • Authorization code.
  • Access token and refresh token.
  • Shop cipher.
  • Signed API request parameters.
  • Product import request parameters.

This service is provided by TikTok Shop.

Privacy policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/provelopers-connector-for-tiktok-shop directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Prov Connector in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Connect your TikTok Shop seller account using the API credential settings.
  5. Configure the plugin settings and start importing products.
sections.faq:
Do I need a TikTok Shop account to use this plugin?

Yes. You need an active TikTok Shop seller account to connect the plugin and access the TikTok Shop API.

Will the plugin overwrite my existing WooCommerce products?

The plugin is designed to handle products intelligently. If a product with the same SKU already exists, it will be updated. If no matching SKU is found, a new product will be created.

Where can I get support?

For plugin support and account-related questions, visit the Provelopers support portal at https://provelopers.net/contact.
